# Pinned tensor and Roformer components

- `roformer`: selected source from chenmozhijin/BSRoformer.cpp at `9bc935c477c22b89972374eca096a6311405350c` (v0.1.0), MIT. Used for the network graph and per-chunk STFT/mask/ISTFT. Stemora does not invoke the upstream executable or its whole-track scheduler.
- Adapter changes: explicit session device/thread options; strict CUDA or CPU selection; automatic CUDA then CPU fallback; backend metadata; logs go to stderr; UTF-8 Windows model paths; 64-bit tensor seeks and truncated-data checks. Original licenses are retained.
- By default, the build downloads the SHA-256-pinned BSRoformer.cpp v0.1.0 CUDA 13.1 package for the GGML tensor DLLs. It generates MSVC C API import libraries locally and compiles Stemora's adapter/host/session/overlap-add sources. No upstream executable is distributed or invoked. The CPU DLL is replaced by a local MSVC build from ggml-org/ggml at `3af5f5760e19a96427f5f7a93b79cbdf3d4b265b`, using explicit AVX2/FMA/F16C and disabling AVX-512/AMX. This avoids inheriting the CI machine's native CPU instruction set. The mixed C API runtime is covered by real CPU and CUDA SW inference checks. No Vulkan DLL is linked or loaded.
- `-BuildTensorBackend` is an optional full tensor-source build of GGML CPU/CUDA together at that fixed source commit, with NVIDIA CUDA 13.2.1 and MSVC. The CMake build uses the checkout's headers; `ggml/include` is the matching reference snapshot used by the precompiled C API route. This optional source build was configured successfully, but the current delivered runtime uses the verified precompiled CUDA route. Default full-source CUDA targets are `86-virtual;120a-real`; `-CudaArchitectures` changes deployment targets.
- Bootstrap source and all NVIDIA runtime/compiler archives use fixed versions and SHA-256 checks. `-Proxy` or `STEMORA_DOWNLOAD_PROXY` controls only these requests. The local source checkout is downloaded from codeload without relying on GitHub API rate limits.
- CUDA runtime, cuBLAS and cuBLASLt DLLs are distributed under NVIDIA's redistribution terms. Their notices are copied to `licenses/NVIDIA-*.txt`. MSVC CRT/OpenMP app-local DLLs are copied from the installed toolset's designated redistributable directories; `licenses/MSVC-Redistributable.txt` identifies their redistribution source.
- `scripts/Build-Native.ps1 -CpuOnly` compiles a separate CPU-only CI/test distribution into `artifacts/native-cpu`. It does not require the CUDA toolkit or a GPU, and explicit `--device cuda` returns an error. The normal build outputs the combined CUDA/CPU runtime into `artifacts/native`.

The model registry, C ABI, session ownership, output routing, cancellation boundary, host protocol and weighted overlap-add scheduler are implemented in `native/src`. New architectures implement `ModelAdapter` and register factories without changing the GUI or public CLI result schema.
